title: Compare approved supplier quotes with purchase order prices
description: Add a development-only read-only price-variance view for explicitly linked purchase-quote lines and generated purchase orders. Compare only matching product, specification, unit, currency and tax basis, using the existing conversion source marker plus persisted order link; ambiguous or stale links remain unresolved. Do not reprice orders or change approvals. No migration, production SQL, real database execution, irreversible data action, secret change or deployment.
acceptance_criteria: An authenticated bounded GET view filters converted purchase quotes by date and optional supplier and returns stable paged source-to-order rows.

For uniquely matched quote and order lines with identical comparison basis, the view shows unit-price and extended-amount deltas; ambiguous, mismatched, deleted or unlinked rows show explicit unresolved reasons without numeric variance.
The purchase-quote page opens a read-only price-variance view with source and order evidence and no conversion or edit action.

Focused unit tests cover single and batch conversion, duplicate products, mismatched units/currency/tax, stale links, paging and no-write behavior; safe Release validation passes and rules are documented.
